conclusion: a first concrete HI bad closed prefix maps to a legal reference prefix containing a corresponding HI bad event
exact_statement: For every first finite concrete HI bad closed prefix, the closed-prefix refinement, reference-prefix extension, release-fixed removal mapping, deadline observation, HI nontruncation, effective event frontier relation, and early-stop configuration gate imply a corresponding first finite reference HI bad prefix. N6 only proves the concrete first HI bad prefix maps to the reference first HI bad prefix; it does not assume or prove reference safety or schedulability.
